problems.missingRole: Choose a role to run this step.
problems.missingAgent: Choose an agent to run this step.

palette.entryHint: Click to add, or drag onto the canvas
palette.title: Add a step

inspector.name: Name
inspector.keyHint: Identifies this step in run logs. Renaming it keeps its incoming branches.
inspector.summarizerNote: The summarizer runs automatically before the first step and its digest goes to every agent below, so it can't be a step. This step is skipped when a report runs.
inspector.humanNote: The run pauses here until someone holding this role acts on the report. Steps are assigned to a role, not to a named person.
inspector.inactiveAgent: This agent is inactive, so the step won't run until it is reactivated.
inspector.nothingToBranchSkipped: Nothing to branch on — this step is skipped.
inspector.chooseAgentForDecisions: Choose an agent to see the decisions it can reach.
inspector.noDecisions: This agent declares no decisions, so there is nothing to branch on. Add some on the AI Agents page.
inspector.notDeclared: not a decision of this agent
inspector.noOutcomes: No outcomes — once the person acts, the report continues to the next step.
inspector.dragHint: You can also drag from an outcome's dot on the canvas to the step it should go to.
inspector.oneAtATime: Only one workflow runs at a time.
inspector.oneAtATimeOther: Only one workflow runs at a time. Saving stands down "{{name}}".
inspector.maxVisitsHint: How many times one step may run for a single report. Bounds send-back loops.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.seoDescription: The stages a new report runs through.
workflows.noSteps: No steps yet — open the builder to add some.
workflows.newTileText: Connect agents and people into the route a report takes.
workflows.intro: The route a new report takes — which AI agents look at it, in what order, and when a person takes over.
workflows.noneRunningBody: New reports have nothing to run through. Choose "Use for new reports" on one of the workflows below.
workflows.emptyBody: A workflow decides what happens to a new report — which agents look at it, in what order, and when a person takes over.
workflows.switchBody: New reports will run through "{{name}}". Reports already in progress keep the workflow they started with.
workflows.switchBodyInstead: New reports will run through "{{name}}" instead of "{{current}}". Reports already in progress keep the workflow they started with.
workflows.needsOne: An organization always needs one workflow. Create its replacement first.
workflows.deleteActiveWarning: It is the active workflow — activate another first, or new reports will have nothing to run through.

editor.emptyHint: Pick an agent or a role from the list, or press + to add the first step.
editor.leaveMessage: Your changes to this workflow haven't been saved and will be lost.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.seoDescription: Your organization’s region and jurisdiction pack.
jurisdiction.intro: The rules your organization’s cases follow: deadlines, business days, minimum retention and regulators. Set up by Xposer; contact us to change them.
jurisdiction.noPack: None. Deadlines and retention follow each report type.
jurisdiction.entityNote: A legal entity can follow a different pack from the same region.
jurisdiction.noActiveVersion: {{code}} has no active version yet, so it doesn’t apply to cases. Below is the latest draft; cases work as before until it’s signed off and activated.
jurisdiction.retentionFromSubmission_one: {{count}} year from submission. A report type can keep cases longer, never shorter.
jurisdiction.retentionFromSubmission_other: {{count}} years from submission. A report type can keep cases longer, never shorter.
jurisdiction.retentionFromClosure_one: {{count}} year from when the case is closed. A report type can keep cases longer, never shorter.
jurisdiction.retentionFromClosure_other: {{count}} years from when the case is closed. A report type can keep cases longer, never shorter.
jurisdiction.businessDaysIntro: Business-day deadlines skip these. When a holiday is added, deadlines still running move later.
jurisdiction.packsIntro: The packs a legal entity can follow.

entities.title: Legal entities
entities.seoDescription: The companies your organization is made of.
entities.intro: The companies your organization is made of. The AI works out which one each report is about, and staff can correct it on the case.

errors.code: Lower-case letters, digits, _ and - only, such as acme_difc.
errors.name: Enter the English name.
errors.currency: A three-letter ISO code, such as AED or SAR.
errors.retention: A whole number of years, 1 or more.

entities.toastDeactivated: Entity deactivated. Cases already filed keep it.

fields.codeHint: Permanent once added. Lower-case, such as acme_difc.
fields.aliasesHint: Press Enter after each one, such as “Acme DIFC” or “Gate Village office”.
fields.aliasesPlaceholder: Add a name and press Enter
fields.descriptionHint: What this entity does and where, in a sentence or two.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Insurance branch in DIFC selling commercial lines.
fields.packHint: Only if this entity follows a different pack from your organization’s.
fields.packHintWithDefault: Only if this entity follows a different pack from your organization’s ({{pack}}).
fields.currencyHint: Used for money answers on this entity’s cases.
fields.regulatorsHint: Codes, such as DFSA. Press Enter after each.
fields.retentionHint: Optional. The pack’s minimum still applies.

entities.aiNote: Reporters are never asked which entity a report is about. The AI matches what they write against these names, so add trading names, abbreviations and locations.
entities.emptyBody: Add one for each company or branch, such as an insurer, a bank or a DIFC branch, so the AI can tell reports apart.
